# Gears — Fandom OCs

**Identification uncertain:** Several unrelated MLP fan characters are named Gears. The catalog does not identify a creator or continuity. The following are independently documented candidates, not interchangeable identities.

## Gears (Ask the Guard Ponies)

A golden-brown stallion with swept-back dark brown hair, bright blue eyes and a gray military uniform. He is an engineering student drafted into wartime service. His name is used in the original illustrated dialogue; no longer name, cutie mark or voice actor was verified. He belongs to the [Guardverse fan continuity](https://www.tumgik.com/asktheguardponies), rather than an established Friendship is Magic television role. He has written dialogue.

[![Gears, upper left, in a cast interview — Ask the Guard Ponies](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/9/3399__source%2Bneeded_useless%2Bsource%2Burl_safe_artist-colon-asktheguardponies_derpibooru%2Bimport_caboose_minuette_oc_oc-colon-blitz_oc-colon-gears_oc-colon.png)](https://twibooru.org/3399)

## Other documented Gears characters

- **Get in Gear:** PaintTasticPony's robot pony, discovered discarded in a Canterlot alley with no memory of his past. The [creator's project announcement, archived on Tumgik](https://www.tumgik.com/tag/get%20in%20gear) identifies him as Gears in the Paintiverse. Written dialogue is present; no voice actor verified. The comic is set around the introduction of the Cutie Map, not an official season-five appearance. The art assets could not be retrieved for visual verification.
- **Gears Worker:** A unicorn mechanic with a five-pronged cog cutie mark who plays electric guitar in a punk/metal band with his childhood friend Cross Sticks, as described in the [July 2013 Indiana Brony Branch character introduction](https://indianabronybranch.weebly.com/ask-the-ponies).
- **Gears (changeling):** G3AR B0X's hivekeeper, whose disguise is a cloud-gray pegasus stallion with blue hair, pale-blue tips and two gears as his cutie mark. Both forms use the same name, according to the [February 2018 Fimfiction character submission](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/790742/the-nameless-queens-hive).

## Important moments

- **Drafted before finishing school — Ask the Guard Ponies, cast interview (illustration above):** Gears explains that conscription interrupted his studies at Cloudsdale Engineering Academy, even before he could dismantle his final project.
- **Discarded and searching for answers — Get in Gear, opening premise:** The robot's missing memories drive his search for his origins.
- **Regaining awareness — Get in Gear, installment #9:** He asks where he is, showing his confusion in the [archived comic feed](https://www.tumgik.com/askgears).

These moments concern two different fan continuities. Television episode numbers and video timestamps are not applicable; no official show appearances were verified. The exact catalog match remains unresolved, and additional artwork was omitted rather than attributed to the wrong pony.
